prompt: write me a moody piano progression in F# minor, 8 bars, slow

cells.source:
set tempo 56
set key F#
set mode minor

chords pair = 1m7 6maj7
chords cycle = pair|second(pair, -1)|second(pair, -2)|fourth(pair)|pair|second(pair, -1)|second(pair, -2)|5dom7 -
notes roots = 1-------6-------
notes line = roots|second(roots, -1)|second(roots, -2)|fourth(roots)|roots|second(roots, -1)|second(roots, -2)|5---------------

play block {
  with octave 4 { piano: chords cycle, },
  with octave 2 { bass: notes line, },
}
